_comment: The PDF text extractor drops superscripts, so exponents arrive as loose digits (x 2 instead of x²). A blanket regex is unsafe — it corrupts legitimate coefficients like 'equation 2y' — so corrections are listed explicitly per question and verified against the source PDF.
